release.name: V15.1 ROS2 simulation prototype
limits: Lockstep validation only; policy-tick compute P99 87.32ms exceeds20ms period.
One flat seed42 28s sequence; repeated cycles, rough terrain and real hardware not validated for this optimization.
Crouch is four-foot-supported, not belly-supported sitting or fallen recovery.
Final26.5–28s front knees RMS19.903/18.934Nm exceed18Nm continuous rating; rear9.638/9.878Nm. Thermal endurance unverified.
Peak torque limits unchanged24.8/48Nm; motorAK10-9V3.0 datasheet peak53Nm is distinct from48Nm simulator setting.
Walking torque is instantaneous PD estimate; current is ideal torque conversion, not DC bus current or direct ADC-limit verdict.
Cross-leg contacts and same-leg thigh-foot enclosing proxies checked; no actual trunk collider or complete CAD interference certification.
Stairs602: ascent failed; no new stair claim, V16 stairs skipped.
release.default_change_since625: Only configured defaults changed: crouch_forward_shift_m0→0.15 and crouch_shift_after_walk_only false→true in node/launcher.625 explicitly used these selected values. Frozen625 preserved; final actualDDS/package65tests passed with deployed source/Cyclone. Earlier-candidate DDS cases explicitly set scope=false to retain test coverage.

limitations: Posthoc analysis; thresholds reuse existing v14_path_metrics.py but were not applied by the raw ROS2 evaluator.
Ground is reconstructed from the configured single-tile mesh and initial center assumption; actual terrain origins and ground rays were not recorded.
The geometry-derived ground height is under the root XY, not beneath each foot; this is not a measurement of foot support.
Same-leg negative gaps mean conservative foot-box proxy overlap, not confirmed physical mesh contact.
No new simulation, original result change, or claim beyond the existing directed/full-flight corridor contract.

This adds retrospective geometry evidence, not a new physical validation or change to original task success.

motor_specs.current_model: I_tau_ideal=abs(joint output torque)/(motor Kt * gear ratio), eta=1, same torque-current convention as manufacturer Kt. Not DC bus/battery current; no winding, inverter, thermal or regenerative model.
motor_specs.current_limit_verdict: undetermined: manufacturer ADC rated/peak current cannot be directly equated to torque-producing current without a documented current convention and drive mapping. Nominal/peak torque-current pairs are not consistent with the listed Kt*gear ratio, especially AK10-9 V3.0.
motor_specs.efficiency_sensitivity: For constant eta=0.85, multiply current estimates by 1/0.85=1.17647. This is sensitivity, not measured efficiency.
motor_specs.thermal_verdict: Rated-torque exceedance and short-window RMS are screening metrics, not a temperature or continuous-duty safety certificate.

limitations: 전류는 |토크|/(Kt×감속비), 효율1 가정의 이상적 환산이며 배터리 전류가 아니다.
601은 lockstep 평지 시퀀스 검증이다. 정책 틱 계산 P99 약 82.82 ms로 50 Hz 실시간 실기 운전은 검증되지 않았다.
601 최종 crouch의 네 무릎 RMS 20.44/24.24/28.44/25.49 Nm는 모두 정격 18 Nm를 넘는다. 낮은 자세를 장시간 유지할 열 안전성은 미검증이다.
보행 토크는 순간 implicit PD 추정값이다. 영게인 기립은 feedforward 명령을 사용하며 PhysX 구동력 실측이 아니다.
정격 8.3/18 Nm와 시뮬레이션 상한 24.8/48 Nm를 구분한다. 열 안전성·지속 운전은 미검증이다.
실제 접촉 채널과 기하학적 캡슐/몸통 프록시는 별도 증거다. 필터된 쌍의 무충돌을 증명하지 않는다.
현재 비교는 seed42 평지·거친 지형이다. 생략된 거친 지형은 통과가 아니며 계단 검증도 아니다.
이 보고서는 기존 JSON 판정을 표시하며 후보 선택이나 채택 게이트를 변경하지 않는다.
